## Selected Work

- Karmaclub: admin dashboard, entrepreneur portal, and investor-facing funding flows for a project investment platform.
- YOLO Padel: multi-venue padel court booking platform with online payments, dynamic pricing, RBAC, and an admin dashboard.
- AYANA Rewards: offline-first mobile loyalty app for hotel staff with AI-powered receipt OCR and background sync.
- Swasana Wedding: wedding venue booking management with an end-to-end leads pipeline for the sales team.
